item.title: Everything We Know About Ariana Grande’s ‘Petal’ (So Far)
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Get ready, Arianators. The wait is over. Ariana Grande just dropped some major news, and we're here to break it down for you. The pop star has officially announced her eighth studio album, Petal, is on the way."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Grande made the big reveal on Instagram just yesterday, and it's been a long time coming. She's been hinting at new music for a while now, even changing her Instagram bio to include a flower emoji. And let's be real, her schedule has been crazy busy. From releasing the Wicked saga to starring in the upcoming Meet the Parents film, Focker-in-Law, and even making her West End debut in 2027, Grande has been non-stop."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But amidst all that, she's found time to work on Petal, the follow-up to her 2024 chart-topping album, Eternal Sunshine. That album brought us two Billboard Hot 100 number one hits, and we can't wait to see what Petal has in store. The album is set to drop in the middle of Grande's Eternal Sunshine tour, which kicks off June 8th in Oakland, California, and wraps up September 1st in London."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all we know for now, but stay tuned for more updates on Petal. Are you excited for new Ariana Grande music? Let us know. We'll be back with more news and updates soon."
